<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Stationery, bookstore and toy retailer in Uruguay with physical stores and an online store. Sells school supplies, office products, art supplies, books, technology and toys. States shipping to the whole country, free above a stated cart threshold, and same-day delivery for orders placed before 14:00.
